findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "section" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The ranked stories of one Daily Markdown section: x (key voices), github, infrastructure (data centers, power, chips and what tokens cost), models." → after: "The ranked stories of one Daily Markdown section: x (X posts linked from Hacker News, then Bluesky and Mastodon posts), github, infrastructure (data centers, power, chips and what tokens cost), models."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
